points.pass_hat_k_unmeasured_reason: no attempt carried a pass criterion — no goal-state check and no judge — so there is nothing for pass^k to conjoin: it is unmeasured, not 0; read the arm's own grade (its host measures, e.g. accuracy) instead

frontier_bar_withheld: withheld — no bar was supplied to the frontier lens, so it names no verdict and each subject's n_cleared_bar is a default of 0, not a count of arms that failed a bar. The bars this campaign is held to are adjudicated in bar_adjudications. This campaign is held to no bar, declared or registered.

axes.rationale: does any arm do better than baseline

cost_unmeasured: Cost was not measured: no result reported its spend, so the $0 each one stores is not a measurement and cost is neither charted nor tested. A quick candidate reports its spend by returning an Answer.

judge_drift.disclosure: Drift compares two judges on the same evidence: it detects whether the scores moved, never which judge is right. Whether either judge agrees with people is what calibration measures.

families.disclosure: This campaign declares no live question, so every comparison it holds — each contrast against the control, on every reading on a merit axis — is corrected as one family. 1 comparison the campaign holds carried a p and was corrected together by Holm's method at α=0.05; a separation stands only where the adjusted p is below it and the interval excludes zero. Each interval is at 95%, so the family's intervals hold together at 95%.

reading_scope.disclosure: This campaign declares no live question, so every finding it supports is exploratory: nothing was asked before the evidence was read, and a pattern found in it is a lead for a campaign that asks, not an answer.

factor_pairs.completeness: 1 factor varied, so no pair of factors could co-vary.
factor_pairs.interaction_aliasing: Only pairs of factors are checked: a factor that moved with a combination of two others (C = A⊕B, an interaction) is not detected, so it is neither grouped nor shown.

accuracy.name: accuracy
accuracy.description: Share of classifications matching the expected label — the classifier family's quality measure, derived by the engine from each observation's `match` (a host lands `match` and never this). Scenario-bound: it means only what the labelled set means.
accuracy.formula: 1 when the observation's match is true, 0 when it is false; its mean is correct / total
accuracy.reader_prose: how often a classification matched its expected label

confusion_cell.name: confusion_cell
confusion_cell.description: Which cell of the confusion matrix one classification landed in. Counted, never averaged: the counts over a cell's results are its confusion matrix, from which per-label precision, recall and F1 are derived.
confusion_cell.formula: the expected label and the predicted one, as `expected → predicted` (see confusion_cell)

execution_mode.name: execution_mode
execution_mode.description: Whether the observation was made while other eval work was executing — another run holding a concurrency slot (never one queued for it), or other cells of its own run, which executes its cells concurrently when its launch did not declare latency under test. A condition, not a result: a `concurrent` observation's latency is kept out of every comparison, bar and ranking, and disclosed as withheld.

match.name: match
match.description: Whether one classification matched its expected label. The one a classifier kind lands; the engine derives `accuracy`, the quality measure, from it.

time_axis_withheld: every run started on one day (2026-10-14) and the host labels no build
